items.title: How Zimmer Biomet accelerated in silico clinical trials more than 1,000x with AWS
items.summary: In this post, we share how Zimmer Biomet, working with AWS, Invisibl Cloud, Ansys (part of Synopsys), and Dassault Systèmes, changed what a medical device engineering team can accomplish by using AWS to scale the process of computational simulations. The team started from a previous in silico clinical trial (a clinical trial done on the computer using virtual, realistic patient models) for a shoulder replacement implant. That study, conducted on-premises, took over 3 months to complete 1,042 successful simulations of virtual surgeries. The team then ran a scaled version of the study, with a goal of completing 30,000 successful simulations, start to finish, in under 24 hours on AWS. The run actually delivered 46,662 successful simulations in a single day, about 45 times the original study.
items.creator: Philippe Favre
